objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed information object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and other controlled documents in the system.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix assigned to the document (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: System-assigned sequential number for the document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on each revision or edit cycle.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document within the status network (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope designation printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time period (default 3 years) after which the document must be reviewed for continued validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period (default 10 years) for archived documents before physical deletion.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute linking the document to relevant IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute specifying relevant companies the document applies to.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute specifying organizational or geographic areas where the document is valid.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author responsible for the document.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned write permissions on the document alongside the author.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to technically and formally review the document content.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document for distribution.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment controlling which readers may view the released document.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute controlling email notification distribution upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute controlling acknowledgement-based distribution upon release of a new version.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system may view the document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification category that determines the level and type of a document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Language-independent abbreviation code for the document type (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Default period for validity extension checks, configurable per document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Default archival retention period, configurable per document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata printing.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document appended to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document's release cycle.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information object appended to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changing an existing released document, managed in the document cockpit and tracked through to implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate a released document and initiate the archiving process, created by users with write access.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restricted to the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for assigning authorizations, distribution, and role-based access to documents.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process that manages approval steps including creation, review, and release with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task, documented per released version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement distribution upon release.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Active confirmation by a recipient on the distribution list that they have read and noted a released document version.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific document filing.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents via master data references.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application master data object that can be referenced by documents.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific interface displaying relevant documents, tasks, and evaluation information based on distribution group assignments.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation providing filtered results lists of documents based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the report such as Status Report, Document Monitoring, or Acknowledgement Report.

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable filter criteria influencing evaluation results.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational unit in a multi-client system where document visibility can be controlled.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: A language-dependent version of a released document that must go through its own review and release workflow before becoming visible.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document content is translated.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is created in the system by selecting a document type and optionally a template, and the creator is registered as the author.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The document content is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the creation step as the first step of the release workflow using an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content according to technical and formal aspects and completes the review task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_document_in_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, completing the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_document_in_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, causing the workflow to be canceled for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created, retaining all data from the previous version for revision.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: A supplementary additional information object is added to a document without affecting the release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted directly from a document without creating a new version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights, without affecting the document's content or version.

evts.name: notify_author_of_change_proposal
evts.description: The author of the underlying document is informed by email when a change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal_for_implementation
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document in which the proposal note can be printed.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of the assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator by email.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser or release participants confirm the document's additional validity, updating the valid-until date and deleting the validity extension request.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for override to invalidate a released document and initiate archiving.

evts.name: process_override_request
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow resulting in the document being declared out of force.

evts.name: declare_document_out_of_force
evts.description: A document is declared out of force, its status is updated, edited versions are deleted, and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is archived for a defined retention period with all authorizations revoked except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted from the system after the archive duration has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by the Business Admin group to re-validate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: A previously invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, distribution lists, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list are informed by email notification about the new document version.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement of the document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: assign_user_to_user_group
evts.description: A user is assigned to a user group by technical administration for role-based authorization.

evts.name: assign_authorization_to_document
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to users or user groups for a specific document.

evts.name: create_translation
evts.description: A language-dependent translation of a released document is created for a target language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is reviewed for content accuracy and formal correctness.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is approved and released, making it visible to authorized readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: The visibility of a document is configured for specific clients in a multi-client system.

o2o.description: Each document is classified by a document type that determines its level and category.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can have one or more controlled attachments appended to it.
A document can have one or more additional information objects appended to it.
Change proposals belong to and are managed within a specific document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
A request for override is created for and linked to the document to be invalidated.
A request for reactivation references the invalidated document to be reactivated.
Documents can reference other documents via the references attribute.
Documents can be linked to organizational units for organizational filing.
Documents can be linked to business processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to risk objects via master data references.
Documents can reference IT application master data objects.
Each document has a distribution list specifying user groups and persons for notification and acknowledgement.
A released document can have one or more translations into different languages.
A document's visibility can be controlled per client in a multi-client system.
A distribution list contains user groups assigned for email notification or acknowledgement distribution.
A distribution list can contain individual persons assigned for distribution.
Users are assigned to user groups for role-based authorization and access control.
Documents are processed through workflow-supported release processes.
Workflow participants complete their tasks with electronic signatures documented per released version.
Documents assigned via distribution groups appear on user and role-specific dashboards.
